question: Does retaining the newly connected, measured instrument-boundary recipe reduce target research cost independently of an unchanged fresh boundary planner?

development_pilot.finding: UnifiedObjectLab naturally learns an at-boundary recipe and reapplies it across measurement names, apparatuses and object counts. Direct AnonymousObjectLab fitting without object discovery does not produce membership candidates; it is outside this comparison.

intervention: Delete only inherited records with instrument_recipe.sequence_mode == learned_boundary. Keep the fitted target model, paid prefix, other methods, fresh planner and local method learning identical. Both targets start independently from the frozen source book.
laboratory: UnifiedObjectLab; source has 4 objects, public object schema, fine instruments. For task seed s use seed=s, apparatus_seed=s+1009, rename_prefix=s{s}_. Target task seed is source seed plus its specified offset.
terminal: Evaluate frozen survivors on independent actual readings: a random trajectory, independent low/mid/high probes on each public control, and half-grid probes across the publicly named focus control. Every measured field must have survivors, all of which must have maximum squared error <= tolerance. Terminal data never alter the model or method book; costs are separate.
accounting: Fit the shared target prefix once and copy its cost to each counterfactual arm. Include the same source acquisition cost once per two-target sequence in each arm. Report target-only and source-inclusive costs. Retain all 30 sources, including unsuccessful acquisitions and all unmodeled fields.
analysis: Pair by source seed, summing its two targets. Report raw totals and source-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals for keep-minus-delete cost differences, using 10000 resamples and fixed analysis seed 20261007. Do not treat 60 targets as 60 independent source-method acquisitions.
scope: Finite role-labelled instrument family, with changes of measurement names, apparatus coefficients and object count. Existing half-integer membership law and supplied role schema remain; this is not anonymous structure discovery, unseen threshold-family invention or end-to-end LLM evidence. No model/provider calls.
